description: Defines a custom JTable subclass for displaying and interacting with parameter lists in an ECU tuning application, including custom cell rendering, editing, and tooltips.

classes.name: ParameterListTable
classes.description: A specialized JTable for displaying ECU parameter data with custom rendering, editing, and tooltip support.

methods.name: ParameterListTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with a model and configuring column sorting.

methods.name: getCellRenderer
methods.description: Returns custom cell renderer for combo boxes based on cell content.

methods.name: getCellEditor
methods.description: Returns custom cell editor for combo boxes based on cell content.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Provides tooltip text based on parameter description.

methods.name: displayComboBox
methods.description: Determines if a cell should display a combo box based on its data type and convertors.

methods.name: setColumnSortable
methods.description: Configures whether a column is sortable.
